column1: # Finnish (fi) catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
#   context  empty                a plain UI string; `source` is the English text in the code
#            @id                  a command id (e.g. file.saveAs): wins over the English text for
#                                 that menu item, so one id can read differently from its twin
#            @plural              `source` is "one|other" (English forms); the translation lists the
#                                 language's forms separated by "|" (see `plural` in i18n.rs)
#            anything else        a disambiguating context passed to `tr_ctx`
#   escapes  \n  \t  \  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both columns.
#   lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored.
# Combined from the community Finnish catalogs in #5666 and #6961: each row takes the best of their
# translations, with one term per concept across the UI (taso, valinta, maski, liukuväri,
# pehmennys, muunnos, vapaa muunnos, ruudukko, apuviiva, piirtoalusta, kangas, leikkausmaski,
# työtila, sivellin, sekoitustila, säätö, kanava, polku, historia, asiakirja, suodatin, reunaviiva,
# taivutus, edustaväri, tasoasetelma, heittovarjo …). Clean-room: written from the plain meaning of
# the English labels; no proprietary localisation resource was consulted or copied.
# Labels use sentence case, commands are imperatives, and pointer hints say what an action does
# ("Lisää piste napsauttamalla"). Product, format and technology names (PhotoCraft, ArtCraft,
# OpenType, CMYK, Lab …) and key caps keep their spelling; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is
# kept. Numbers follow Finnish style (decimal comma, a space before %). Plural rule: one|other
# (n != 1 -> other); the other form takes the partitive singular ("1 taso", "2 tasoa").
# Native-speaker review of the remaining specialist terms is welcome.
# Layer Mask Display Options (the layer mask rubylith's colour and opacity)
# Channel Options and New Spot Channel (#3761)
